public_rationale: On April 18, 2024, Meta documented search integration across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger [e1]. It described question answering and image generation, with real-time image generation beginning as a US beta on WhatsApp and the web [e1]. On May 9, Guiding Tech reported no setting to disable Meta AI in any of the four apps [e2]. On April 19, Global News quoted Meta confirming that users could not disable its search integration [e3]. Group administrators could turn off AI participation in groups, but the report distinguished that control from disabling Meta AI's general presence [e3]. This supports the claim for the April–May 2024 rollout in supported countries, with “impossible to disable” understood as lacking a complete off switch in current app settings [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The rollout announcement does not establish availability to every account or country, or identical image-generation features across all four apps [e1].
Group controls and reported workarounds qualify the absolute wording, but do not establish complete removal through current app settings [e2, e3].
These sources do not establish whether the same controls remained in place after May 2024 [e1, e2, e3].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Meta AI is an impossible-to-disable assistant available across virtually every Facebook property.

statement.excerpt: Yet Meta’s most confusing addition to the platform is Meta AI, a “free” (and impossible-to-disable) artificial intelligence assistant that lets users ask questions and generate images from virtually any Facebook property.

our_interpretation: Facebook property means Meta's four main social and messaging apps: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger.
Impossible to disable means that ordinary users of the current apps had no setting to remove the integrated assistant entirely.
Muting, deleting a conversation, disabling group participation, or using an older app is distinct from disabling the assistant throughout the current app.
The observation concerns the April–May 2024 rollout in supported countries, rather than availability to every account worldwide.
For this ongoing product-state claim, the target period is the rollout immediately preceding the post.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous documentation establishes the assistant's question-answering and image-generation capabilities across the four main apps, and contemporary tests or company statements establish the absence of a complete user-facing off switch.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented ordinary setting completely disabled the integrated assistant, or the assistant was absent from a substantial part of the named app family during the rollout.

evidence.explanation: The launch announcement documents integration across all four main apps, free access, questions, and image generation. Its geographic rollout limits do not support universal worldwide availability.

evidence.excerpt: no way to disable Meta AI
evidence.explanation: The contemporary guide reports no complete off switch in the app settings. It separately discusses profile blocking and downgrading, which do not establish such a setting.
